title: SBI returns to dollar bond market after a year, prices five-year notes 88 bps over US Treasury - The Economic Times
text:
State Bank of India is targeting up to $500 million through a five-year dollar bond after attracting over $2 billion in peak orders. Strong demand enabled SBI to tighten pricing guidance, highlighting robust investor appetite for its debt.
